messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: Trouble installing pre-release version of unmarked on Mac
parts:
You don't need the pre-release version of unmarked to use occuMulti, it's available in the version on CRAN. Can you elaborate on why you can't use the function? Did you try updating to the newest version the normal way with 

install.packages('unmarked')

?

If you want to continue to try to install the source package you need an additional argument:

install.packages("~/Documents/R scripts and data/MultiOcc_R/Rzip/unmarked_0.12-3-2.tar", repos = NULL, type="source")
